findings.title: .env file committed or not ignored
findings.remediation: Add the file to .gitignore, then remove it from git with `git rm --cached`.

findings.title: Weak or empty application secret
findings.message: JWT_SECRET is weak or too short
findings.remediation: Generate a random value of at least 32 characters (Laravel: `php artisan key:generate`).

findings.title: Weak or empty application secret
findings.message: SESSION_SECRET is weak or too short
findings.remediation: Generate a random value of at least 32 characters (Laravel: `php artisan key:generate`).

findings.title: Permissive CORS configuration
findings.message: CORS allows any origin with credentials
findings.remediation: List the exact origins that need access instead of '*' or a bare cors() call.

findings.title: Dynamic code execution
findings.message: Code or command is built dynamically
findings.remediation: Avoid eval. Use execFile/spawn with an argument array instead of building a shell string.

findings.title: No automated tests detected
findings.message: No test files or test directories found
findings.remediation: Add a test runner (Jest/Vitest, PHPUnit/Pest) and cover the critical paths.

findings.title: Lockfile missing or out of sync
findings.remediation: Commit the lockfile (npm install / composer install) and keep it in sync.

findings.title: Security headers not configured
findings.message: No helmet or manual security headers found
findings.remediation: Install helmet and add `app.use(helmet())` before your routes.

findings.title: Unpinned dependency version
findings.remediation: Use a bounded range (^1.2.3) or an exact version.

findings.title: Insecure session cookie settings
findings.message: Session cookie sets secure to an unsafe value
findings.remediation: Set `cookie: { secure: true, httpOnly: true, sameSite: 'lax' }`.

findings.title: No rate limiting on authentication routes
findings.message: Authentication route has no rate limiter
findings.remediation: Add express-rate-limit (or similar) to the login, register and reset routes.

findings.title: Unsafe JWT usage
findings.message: jwt.verify does not pin the allowed algorithms
findings.remediation: Read the secret from the environment, pass `algorithms: ['HS256']` to verify, and set `expiresIn` when signing.

findings.title: No license
findings.remediation: Add a LICENSE file (choosealicense.com can help you pick one).

findings.title: No CI workflow
findings.remediation: Add a pipeline (for example GitHub Actions) that runs tests and `devshield scan`.

findings.title: .gitignore missing or incomplete
findings.remediation: Add a .gitignore for your stack that covers dependencies, build output and .env.

findings.title: .env.example missing or incomplete
findings.remediation: Create .env.example with every key from .env and placeholder values.

findings.title: README missing or nearly empty
findings.remediation: Describe what the project does, how to install, run and test it.

findings.title: Development tool in production dependencies
findings.remediation: Move it to devDependencies (npm) or require-dev (Composer).

findings.title: X-Powered-By header exposes Express
findings.remediation: Call `app.disable('x-powered-by')` or use helmet.

findings.title: Insecure session cookie settings
findings.message: Session cookie does not set sameSite
findings.remediation: Set `cookie: { secure: true, httpOnly: true, sameSite: 'lax' }`.

findings.title: CONTRIBUTING or CHANGELOG missing
findings.remediation: Add CONTRIBUTING.md and CHANGELOG.md.

findings.title: CONTRIBUTING or CHANGELOG missing
findings.remediation: Add CONTRIBUTING.md and CHANGELOG.md.
